name: Domaine Grand Veneur Châteauneuf-du-Pape Vieilles Vignes 2016
text:
## Grand Veneur Châteauneuf-du-Pape Vieilles Vignes 2016

**Story.** [Domaine Grand Veneur](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Domaine+Grand+Veneur,+Orange,+France&t=k) was established in 1976 by Alain Jaume and is now run by the sixth generation. The 2016 is 50% Grenache, 40% Mourvèdre and 10% Syrah. That is an unusually Mourvèdre-heavy blend for Châteauneuf.

**Reviews.** Critics scored it very high and fairly consistently.
- Jeb Dunnuck: 100 (tasted Aug 2018, confirmed on his site; he puts it in the same league as the perfect 2010). His note gives the blend as 45% Grenache, 45% Mourvèdre and 10% Syrah, which differs from the 50/40/10 above, so check the label.
- Wine Advocate (Joe Czerwinski): 97 (Aug 2018), now 98 (May 2022).
- Wine Cellar Insider (Jeff Leve): 98.
- Vinous (Josh Raynolds): 93–95.

One CellarTracker taster in 2019 described 98 pop-and-pour, then 95 and 93 on later bottles as it closed up. CellarTracker community score, from your list: 95.1 (2016).

**Practical note.** Czerwinski gave 2020–2035. Because of that closed-up report, decant for 2–3 hours and don't judge it on the first pour. Try it with braised beef cheeks or roast venison.

**Curious aside: Mourvèdre.** Mourvèdre adds elegance and structure. That is why this blend feels firmer and darker than a Grenache-led wine.

### From the history books
- 1316–1334: John XXII reigns, and built the castle that symbolises the appellation. See [Pope John XXII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Pope+John+XXII&go=Go).
- 1348: the papacy buys Avignon from the Angevins (see [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy)).
- 1976: Alain Jaume founds Grand Veneur (see [this search](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Alain+Jaume+Grand+Veneur&go=Go)).

**Sources:** Jeb Dunnuck (subscriber site, checked directly), Uncorked, Falstaff, Farr Vintners, J.J. Buckley, Vinfolio, FRW, First Bottle, Kysela, Benchmark Wine, K&L, Whwc, Thatchers, Winewithseth, CellarTracker, Delectable, closdesspiritueux.com, and Wikipedia ([Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC), [Nahe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahe_(wine_region)), [Vouvray AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouvray_AOC), [La Clape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massif_de_la_Clape), [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy), [Great French Wine Blight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_French_Wine_Blight)).
